Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Standridge
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/15/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 310 as introduced prohibits state or local public funds from being expended for enforcement of certain presidential executive orders regarding firearms. This bill will not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
